description:
## Problem (reproduced in a CI-like environment by an agent; one regression slipped past local fast runs)
`tests/integration/platforms/common.py` has stub installers that set attributes on adapter modules directly and never restore them. The ClickHouse and LakeSail installers leaked across tests on shared xdist workers and broke a later contract test in CI; they now use `monkeypatch.setattr`. The Databricks, Redshift and other installers in the same file still assign directly. Separately, `pytest -m fast` skips `tests/integration`, so a real regression (the DuckLake force-recreate integration test) was only caught by CI.

## Change
- Convert the remaining installers to `monkeypatch.setattr` (or an equivalent that restores state).
- Add a hermeticity check that fails when a test leaves adapter-module attributes changed.
- Decide whether a small, fast subset of integration tests (such as the DuckLake lifecycle test) should run in the fast tier or in `make pr-preflight`.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Integration tests still skip cleanly without credentials or services.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
